profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ Amazon Web Services | Distributed Systems, Rust
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineer and technologist, specializing in designing, implementing, and operating high-performance, scalable, and resilient distributed systems. I am passionate about solving complex technical challenges and driving innovation in distributed systems, storage, and networking.

I aim to work for a technology-first organization that values engineering excellence and aligns with my expertise. My ideal role is as an individual contributor, where I can take ownership of system design, implementation and operation. I seek to play a key role in organization leadership, contributing to long-term business and technical strategy, as well as, building highly capable and efficient teams aligned with the technology and business goals.

With a deep understanding of large-scale distributed systems, performance optimization, and reliability, I thrive in environments where I can push the boundaries of what’s possible, balancing innovation with practical execution to drive long-term impact.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on correctness and performance-critical, highly-available internal services (distributed log, consensus), which are used as database and storage building blocks.  Recently: design/build/launch a multi-region building block service for DSQL and DDB GT MRSC.

Also working with AWS customers and teams on their multi-region, high-availability and disaster-recovery strategy and design.

Teaching/leading projects and teams in their Rust adoption.

Interview bar-raiser.
positions.insights: Distributed Systems, Software Design and +7 skills

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Growing Cloud Directory teams; contributions focused on storage cost reduction, automation, scaling, and performance optimizations.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical lead and development for various DNS features; technical lead and development for Denial-of-Service (DoS) detection and mitigation features.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Subject matter expert for F5’s DNS (Domain Name System) products.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: DNS Cache, Dynamic DNSSEC and Authoritative DNS features (DNS-Express).

positions.title: PhD Graduate Student
positions.description:
Passed Prelims and began thesis work, but decided to put it on hold for some real work experience (and never looked back).

Research in IC CAD, sensor networks, networking, and distributed systems.  

Teaching assistant in EE42 (beginning undergrad electronics) and EE141 (advanced undergrad IC design).
